svg.title: Intel graph: how Rahul R connects data center and cloud operations
svg.desc: An intel graph with Rahul R at the centre, joined to six domains. Multi-cloud: GCP & Cloud Run; AWS & edge cases; Cloudflare WAF & edge; Hybrid connectivity. Data center: Rack & power; Network operations; Bare-metal lifecycle; DR & failover, started. IaC: Terraform modules; Terragrunt stacks; Drift & policy. CI/CD & GitOps: GitHub Actions; ArgoCD & Helm; GitOps workflows. Security: Workload Identity Fed.; Trivy & Chainguard; Cloud posture. Platform: Kubernetes; LiteLLM & RAG; Blockchain nodes; Multi-cluster Karmada, started; Self-hosted data plane, started. Labelled links: Workload Identity Fed. to GitHub Actions, secures; Terraform modules to GitOps workflows, defines; Rack & power to Hybrid connectivity, extends; Trivy & Chainguard to ArgoCD & Helm, gates; Terraform modules to ArgoCD & Helm, feeds. Callouts: zero trust no long-lived keys in CI; identity federation everywhere; data center first what runs on metal still has to meet cloud bar for security; gitops desired state in the repo, not on someone's laptop. A footer lists how decisions are made: mechanism, least privilege, GitOps, supply chain, observability, and outcomes.

g.text: has to meet cloud bar for security

text.tspan: declarative desired state in version control
harden images; scan in every build
measure uptime, cost, and recovery time
blast radius and SLA over tool fashion

svg.text: Squares show public evidence, not skill level.
